NDT software in Philadelphia: a three-state inspection market

An NDT company based in Philadelphia rarely works only in Philadelphia. The city's own refinery, the former Philadelphia Energy Solutions complex in South Philadelphia, shut down after the 2019 fire and is being redeveloped as the Bellwether District, but the Delaware River corridor is still one of the densest refining and petrochemical stretches on the East Coast. Monroe Energy's Trainer refinery sits in Delaware County, the Marcus Hook industrial complex handles natural gas liquids, and PBF's Paulsboro and Delaware City refineries are a short drive across the river in New Jersey and Delaware. A single crew can work in three states in one week, each with its own radiation program and its own client expectations.

Around that core sits a varied mix of work. Hanwha Philly Shipyard at the former Navy Yard builds commercial ships under classification-society survey. Constellation's Limerick and Peach Bottom nuclear stations run refuelling outages with heavy NDT scopes. Philadelphia Gas Works, the largest municipally owned gas utility in the country, and PECO keep pipeline and distribution crews busy under PHMSA and Pennsylvania PUC oversight. Boeing's Ridley Park rotorcraft plant anchors aerospace inspection, and the pharmaceutical and life-sciences plants across the suburbs need PMI, ferrite and visual inspection of stainless process piping. The typical Philadelphia NDT contractor is a mid-size firm with refinery turnaround crews, a marine or fabrication team, and a small lab doing PMI and hardness, all run from a yard in Delaware County, Northeast Philadelphia or South Jersey.

ERP for NDT companies in Philadelphia

The Atlantis ERP solution is a fully customized ERP for NDT and inspection companies. It covers technician certifications, procedures, equipment calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quoting, timesheets and invoicing in one system, set up for how your company actually works.

For a Philadelphia firm the value is keeping one record per job across very different clients: a refinery turnaround with a strict PO structure, a ship block inspected under ABS or DNV survey, a nuclear outage, a pharma plant's stainless welds. Atlantis NDT, founded by ASNT NDT Level III Anoop Rayavarapu, configures the ERP around your methods, report formats and billing, and supports it after go-live. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with a demo and quote on request. Every module is listed on the ERP apps page; the sections below apply the key ones to Philadelphia-area work.

NDT reporting software for refinery, shipyard and pharma work

The NDT Reports app has 17 report types, including UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday testing and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence and method-specific fields. Reports go through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures.

For the Delaware River refineries, IRIS reports on heat-exchanger tubing, PWHT records, hardness after weld repair and PMI on alloy piping cover a large share of turnaround paperwork, and each report can carry the work order, WPS, drawing, procedure and standard references a refinery QA reviewer checks. For pharma and food-grade stainless work, the ferrite and PMI report types sit alongside VT, so the whole package for a skid or a piping spool is in one place.

Shipyard work is where the marine mode earns its keep. It adds a vessel cover page and photo, inspection location and dates, and the PDF merges the classification-society certificate from the built-in library (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS, ClassNK), the inspector's Level II certificate and the instrument's calibration certificate, with inspection photos in a 2-up grid. That is the package a class surveyor expects, produced without assembling PDFs by hand. Excel, Word, PDF and HTML templates are versioned, and Excel formats are filled by mapping fields to cells. See the NDT Reports app and Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Technician certification tracking software for a multi-client Philadelphia workforce

The Certificates app records every technician certification by scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, industry sector and dates, and computes active, expiring soon, expired or revoked status automatically. A daily check creates warning tasks 90 days before a cert or vision test expires.

Philadelphia firms often hire experienced technicians who came up through shipyards or overseas oil and gas, holding PCN or CSWIP cards, and then certify them to the company's SNT-TC-1A written practice. The ERP holds both side by side, with OJT hours, training hours, exam scores for general, specific and practical parts, and attachments. Certificate templates per scheme define validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours, so a new certification is checked against the rules as it is entered.

Nuclear outage clients at Limerick or Peach Bottom will ask for evidence of qualification, vision testing and radiation training for every person badged in. The employee NDT profile stores highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry, and configurable daily email alerts can go to your QA manager and RSO with a look-ahead period and resend interval you choose. Timesheets warn if anyone books hours while a certificate is invalid. See the Certificates app.

Crew dispatch software for turnarounds across the Delaware River

Team Assignments handles jobs as dispatch records moving through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed. Technicians and equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and an assignment warns you if any of its equipment is out of calibration.

Spring and autumn turnaround seasons are when Philadelphia contractors are most exposed. Two refineries, a chemical plant and a ship delivery can all want crews in the same fortnight. The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days with overlaps blocked, and each technician shows current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date. Mobilisation and demobilisation dates and site GPS coordinates are on every assignment, which helps when the gate a crew needs is one of several at a large complex. Calendar, kanban and list views let the scheduler plan the week and the ops manager see which jobs are still sitting in submitted status waiting for reports. When state lines matter, for instance radiography crews that need to be covered by the right state's authorisation, those checks are configured during implementation. See Team Assignments.

Calibration management software for Philadelphia instruments and PMI analysers

Asset Management tracks every instrument, probe and accessory by serial number, with equipment type, assigned person, condition, asset tag, firmware, accessories and lifecycle status: new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired or disposed. Calibration records capture provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date.

Philadelphia labs that run PMI and hardness alongside UT and RT carry a wide spread of equipment with different calibration cycles, and several of those instruments are expensive enough that you rent them out between jobs. The lifecycle status and the ability to record rental terms keep that visible. The calibration certificate register holds each lab's accreditation number, status and PDF, with expiry alerts. The issue and return workflow records condition at both ends, with supervisor and manager approval, and reservations prevent clashes when two turnarounds want the same IRIS system. The maintenance log covers preventive and corrective work, firmware updates and probe replacements. Consumables, from couplant and penetrant to PPE, carry reorder levels. See the Asset Management app.

Procedures for three states and many clients

The Procedures app keeps a controlled register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and the body text or file. Revisions go through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejection reasons, locked approved revisions and a snapshot of every revision.

A Philadelphia firm might hold one set of procedures for refinery work, another written around a shipyard's class requirements and client-specific versions for a nuclear utility. Keeping revision history in one place means you can show exactly which revision applied on a given date. Approvers get reminders for pending approvals, and an AI-assisted first draft speeds up new procedures, always reviewed and approved by a Level III. See the Procedures app.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Philadelphia contractors

Quotations carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, a global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance that converts into a sales order. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

Refinery clients along the river often issue separate PO lines for labour, equipment and consumables, and they reject invoices that do not match. Invoice lines with cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, billing basis and days or hours make that match straightforward. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup separately, with method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag, overtime multiplier and approval, and approved hours flow into billing. Expenses such as per diems and tolls on the bridges across the river can be re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard gives revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months. See Quotations and Invoicing.

CRM for Philadelphia NDT sales

The CRM app records service line, lead source, NDT service type, industry sector, site country, and estimated technicians and days for each opportunity, and scores leads from 0 to 100 as hot, warm, nurture or cold. Leads can be imported from CSV and enrolled in drip email sequences, with AI-personalised email previews.

For a Philadelphia firm trying to add pharma or marine clients to a refinery-heavy book, that makes it easier to see which sectors are actually converting. The Business Cards app turns a photo of a card from a trade event or a plant visit into a CRM lead in one click. See the CRM app.

Inspection management software in Philadelphia: implementation

Implementation is remote, scheduled around your turnaround calendar. The usual order is discovery of your methods, clients and formats; import of technicians, certificates, vision tests, equipment and calibration certificates from spreadsheets; rebuilding your report templates, including marine packages and client Excel formats; integrations through the open REST API with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation; then training for office staff and field technicians on the offline app. Anything specific to your operation that is not built in is configured during implementation. Ask for a Philadelphia implementation plan.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Philadelphia inspection company?

One system that covers certifications, calibration, dispatch, reports and invoicing is usually the best fit for firms working refineries, shipyards and nuclear plants at once. The Atlantis ERP does that and is configured around your clients.

Can the reports include classification-society certificates for shipyard work?

Yes. Marine mode merges the class-society certificate from a library including DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS and ClassNK, plus the inspector's Level II cert and the calibration certificate, into the report PDF.

Does it support PMI, ferrite and hardness reports?

Yes. PMI, ferrite, hardness and PWHT are among the 17 report types, alongside UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, UT thickness, holiday testing and computed radiography.

Can we hold PCN or CSWIP certificates as well as SNT-TC-1A?

Yes. The ERP records SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and other schemes, each with its own dates and status.

Will it work with our accounting system?

Yes, through the open REST API, which integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How is the Atlantis ERP priced?

It is a quote on request. Ask for a quote and we will scope it to your company.
